title: Implement portable community records and measured journeys through canonical GREG
problem: Native production, existing social memory and TerritoryGraph remain disconnected from owned member history and observed content-to-demand paths.
baseline: PR147 guarded Foundry/media plus fixed DSL protocol; DALE pinned source provides social memory and aggregate analytics, but not portable signed community exports or content sequence cohorts.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Add local signed community records and observed journeys through existing guarded GREG; reuse TerritoryGraph and SQLite.
advantages: Executable portable data and actual retained-event routing.
disadvantages: Serving, moderation and authenticated observation collectors remain open.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Measured operational limitations or mature system integration evidence.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Integrate self-hosted Discourse/Ghost and PostHog with owned deployment.
advantages: Mature community moderation and authenticated ingestion interfaces.
disadvantages: No owned instance is connected; installation/deployment cannot be inferred from fixture tests.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Authorized available owned deployment and verified export/authority contracts.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Signed synthetic members, export/import, hostile mutations, temporal-control fixtures and signed GREG missions in CI.
advantages: Tests integrity and actual machine reachability without live contact.
disadvantages: No real membership, behavioral change or market proof.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Later authorized real-world usage, without postponing buildable machinery.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Leave production disconnected from owned relationships and measured demand.
disadvantages: A tested media component remains an incomplete machine.

roles.position: Complete one machine; native production must connect to owned relationships and performance memory. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Member keys could be mistaken for kernel authority or real-world identity.

roles.position: Reuse canonical GREG, TerritoryGraph and mature SQLite/Ed25519 primitives rather than parallel authority or graph models. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Unsigned edits, replay or changed history could forge interactions.

roles.position: Application signatures do not establish human identity or authority; hostile replay/forgery must fail. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Conversion analytics could fabricate outcomes or causality.

roles.position: Bound stores and paginated exports; preserve transactional failure and replay behavior. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Unbounded or partial export/write operations could lose portability.

roles.position: Keep fixtures, source-declared observations, measured association and verified settlement separate. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Routing could bypass evidence floors or become a second content model.

evidence.claim: Existing organ mechanisms inspected before creating native gaps
evidence.finding: Social relationships and aggregate conversion records exist. They do not implement portable signed community export or retained narrative sequence cohorts; existing clients remain the distribution path.

counterevidence.claim: Local component implementation completes the owned community and measured market outcome
counterevidence.finding: It does not: network serving, enrollment/moderation, authenticated collectors and real-world outcomes remain separate unfinished requirements. States remain PARTIAL.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Join owned community records and performance memory to GREG and existing territory machinery; then continue the next requirement.

advantages.amplified_value: Export/import preserves key identities, posts, corrections and interactions.
No substitute impression or modeled revenue metrics.
Fixtures cannot silently become real customer evidence.
Routes retained visits through the established evidence/retirement model.
Signed GREG missions and independent appraisals reach the implementation.

disadvantages.statement: Member keys could be mistaken for kernel authority or real-world identity.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep public member keys as signed application records only, outside all agent/legal/organ authority registries; explicitly limit identity claims.

disadvantages.statement: Unsigned edits, replay or changed history could forge interactions.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Verify Ed25519 mutations, community binding, per-member predecessor chain and exact idempotency; refuse changed ids and broken chain imports.

disadvantages.statement: Conversion analytics could fabricate outcomes or causality.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require bounded source references, separate fixture/observed tiers, actual retained temporal sequences and receipt-linked integer currency totals; state association limits.

disadvantages.statement: Unbounded or partial export/write operations could lose portability.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Bound event stores and batches, paginate complete export, validate before SQL commit and retain GREG staged atomic persistence.

disadvantages.statement: Routing could bypass evidence floors or become a second content model.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Reuse TerritoryGraph validation, expiry and retirement checks; ignore future visits and emit recommendations without contact or new authority.

entries.position: Do not claim an owned deployed community or true causal demand from private fixtures.
entries.rationale: Key possession and source-declared events do not prove external identity, real adoption or provider settlement.
entries.evidence_threshold: Authenticated live observations, operational moderation/serving and independent outcome evidence.

migration_plan: Add systems32/34/50 to PR147 without changing authority; retain all55 obligations as PARTIAL where operational work remains.

steps: Revert this additive implementation; keep source and negative evidence.
Export signed records before any data migration; leave canonical Gate and authority unchanged.

kill_criteria: Fixtures mixed with observed outcomes or impression-based revenue fabricated.
Stale/retired route published or member keys gain kernel authority.
decision_owner: Kernel/GREG maintainers within authorized development; Alfonso owns consequential decisions
review_trigger: Fresh CI, any changed recipe, and every successful increment; automatically resume parent Body + Organs + Mind objective.
